title: Healthy Creamy Korean Chicken Tagine
description: A fresh and creamy Korean dish featuring cream cheese and tagine-cooked chicken, perfect for a post-workout meal, this recipe is low in fat and rich in flavor, made with healthy ingredients and a unique blend of Korean spices.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the chicken to cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Korean chili flakes, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the softened cream cheese until melted and smooth.
Continue to simmer the tagine for an additional 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot over rice or noodles.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve with additional Korean chili flakes on the side for added heat.
